## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `know-sharepoint-export`, `bc-build`
- **Next:** metrics-scorecard (round prep), dept-plant-diagnosis (savings by plant, status cut), catalog-standardization, deploy-project-order (use case, scope, demand); the ranking feeds step 24 and dept-decision-rights.: `metrics-scorecard`, `dept-plant-diagnosis`, `catalog-standardization`, `deploy-project-order`, `dept-decision-rights`
